items.name: splat
items.description: A binary-splitting tool for decompilation and modding projects, with support for Nintendo 64, PlayStation, PlayStation 2, and PSP binaries.
items.source_evidence: The maintainer README describes splat as a binary-splitting tool for decompilation and modding, lists N64, PSX, PS2, and PSP support, and recommends decomp-toolkit for GameCube/Wii projects.

items.name: decomp-toolkit
items.description: A command-line toolkit for GameCube and Wii decompilation projects, including disc inspection and extraction, DOL/ELF analysis, binary splitting, and linker-script generation.
items.source_evidence: The maintainer README identifies decomp-toolkit as a GameCube/Wii decompilation toolkit and documents disc and executable analysis, DOL splitting, linker-script generation, and integration with objdiff and decomp.me.

items.name: BepInEx
items.description: A plugin-loading and patching framework for Unity, XNA, and other .NET games; its official documentation covers installation, plugin development, and runtime patching.
items.source_evidence: The official repository describes BepInEx as a Unity/XNA game patcher and plugin framework. Its current docs include setup instructions, a C# plugin walkthrough, runtime patching, and installation guidance for Windows, Linux, and macOS.

items.name: MoltenVK
items.description: A Khronos Vulkan portability layer that implements Vulkan graphics and compute functionality over Apple Metal for macOS, iOS, tvOS, and visionOS applications.
items.source_evidence: The Khronos-maintained README describes MoltenVK as a Vulkan portability implementation layered over Apple Metal and lists macOS, iOS, tvOS, and visionOS as target platforms; it also documents SPIR-V to Metal shader conversion.

items.name: ANGLE
items.description: An OpenGL ES implementation and translation layer that maps OpenGL ES 2.0–3.1 content to available backends including Vulkan, desktop OpenGL, Direct3D 9, and Direct3D 11.
items.source_evidence: The README describes translation of OpenGL ES API calls to platform graphics APIs and documents support matrices for OpenGL ES versions, renderers, and platforms. The GitHub repository is labeled a public mirror of the Chromium-hosted upstream.

items.name: Nexus Mods
items.description: A multi-game site for discovering, publishing, and installing game modifications, with tools such as the Vortex mod manager and Collections.
items.source_evidence: The official about page describes Nexus Mods as a mod discovery and publishing platform across thousands of games and documents its Vortex manager, Collections, and creator/community features.
